objective: server/domain/version.ts maxVersion() sorts with sortVersions(), and parseVersion() gives a string that is not a version the sortKey 9999.9999.9999.<raw>, so maxVersion(['v2', 'draft']) returns 'draft' — an unparseable string reported as the newest version. stateEngine.ts, auditEngine.ts and promptCompiler.ts all read the current version through it. Fix: maxVersion considers only strings parseVersion() accepts as valid and returns null when none is; sortVersions and compareVersions are unchanged. PLANNING NOTE (this objective doubles as a live check of the Factory's planner): propose exactly two units — (1) an IMPLEMENTATION unit owning server/domain/version.ts, and (2) a TEST unit owning tests/version.test.ts that depends on (1) and adds the regression. Brain decides whether that decomposition can finish and may rewrite it; do not pre-empt that decision by merging them yourself.
expectedOutcome: maxVersion ignores strings that are not versions, with a regression in tests/version.test.ts.
nonGoals: Changing how sortVersions orders invalid strings

acceptanceConditions.statement: maxVersion(['v2', 'draft']) is 'v2' and maxVersion(['draft']) is null, asserted in tests/version.test.ts by a test that fails before the fix

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; no schema or data change.
